steps.name: Sample structure QC and library-depth assessment
steps.question: Do the 12 skin samples separate by condition (AD lesional vs control) on PCA/sample-distance structure, and how does the low-depth sample_01 (library size ~4x below median) behave relative to its group — is there a data-driven reason to exclude it or should it be kept and down-weighted?

grounding.reason: M-0006 sample structure QC (blind vst/PCA/heatmap) is mandatory before modeling; R-0008/R-0030 forbid silently dropping the flagged low-depth sample_01 — decision must be stated with a reason.

acceptance_criteria: Library size and number of detected genes reported per sample, with sample_01 explicitly flagged and compared to the cohort
Blind VST computed on the raw count matrix and PCA (top 500 variable genes) and a sample-distance heatmap produced, colored by condition
Explicit, stated decision on sample_01 (keep / keep-and-flag / exclude) with justification tied to the QC evidence, not depth alone
Output includes a QC table and PCA/heatmap figures usable by downstream DE step

steps.name: Filter low-count genes and set up DESeq2 design
steps.question: Which of the 12,000 genes have enough read support (>=10 counts in at least 6 samples, the smallest group size) to be tested, and what is the DESeq2 design with control set as the explicit reference level for the AD_lesional vs Control contrast?

grounding.reason: M-0007 minimal pre-filter (10 counts / smallest group size=6) plus R-0036 explicit reference level and named contrast.

acceptance_criteria: Genes retained: at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples (smallest group size)
DESeq2 dataset built from the raw integer count matrix and the 12-sample metadata with condition as a factor, reference level explicitly set to 'control'
Contrast named explicitly as condition, AD_lesional, control
Sample_01 handling from T1S1 applied here (retained with documented caveat, or excluded with stated reason) — decision is carried forward, not re-litigated

steps.name: DESeq2 differential expression: AD lesional vs control
steps.question: Which genes are significantly differentially expressed between AD lesional and control skin (DESeq2 Wald test, BH-adjusted p<0.05, apeglm-shrunken log2FC)?

grounding.reason: M-0001 DESeq2 Wald + apeglm shrinkage (M-0013) is the primary DE method for a 6v6 unpaired fixed-effects design; BH/independent filtering per R-0010/R-0043; NA-outlier flagging per R-0039 (n=6<7 per group).

acceptance_criteria: DESeq2 Wald test run on the filtered count matrix with the design from T1S2
apeglm shrinkage applied to the AD_lesional-vs-control coefficient; both raw and shrunken log2FC reported
Results filtered by BH-adjusted p-value < 0.05 with independent filtering enabled and alpha=0.05 passed to results()

Number of genes tested after filtering and number of DE genes reported; genes with NA padj from Cook's-distance outlier flagging (few replicates, <7/group) reported separately from independent-filtering NAs
Full results table (gene, baseMean, log2FC, shrunken log2FC, pvalue, padj) exported

steps.name: edgeR quasi-likelihood cross-check
steps.question: Do the DESeq2-called differentially expressed genes agree with an independent edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same filtered counts and design, and what is the high-confidence intersection set?

grounding.reason: R-0042 requires a second method (edgeR QLF) as robustness check at n=6/group, reporting overlap as the high-confidence set rather than the union.

acceptance_criteria: edgeR QLF test run on the same filtered count matrix, same design/contrast (AD_lesional vs control), TMM normalization
Genes significant at BH-adjusted p<0.05 reported from edgeR
Overlap (intersection) and method-specific (DESeq2-only, edgeR-only) gene sets reported; intersection labeled as the high-confidence set
Do not report the union as the final DE result

steps.name: Hallmark pathway enrichment (fgsea preranked)
steps.question: Which of the MSigDB Hallmark pathways are enriched (up or down) in AD lesional vs control skin, using the full ranked gene list from the DESeq2 Wald test?

grounding.reason: M-0010 fgsea preranked on Hallmark for human; ranking-statistic choice (R-0007, disputed) resolved to the Wald 'stat' column per default_source rank_metric=stat; no hallmark reference confirmed present in this environment (list_available_refs returned unavailable), so step must self-check availability and report the gap rather than assume.

acceptance_criteria: Full set of tested genes (post pre-filter, pre-significance-cutoff) ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column) — ranking metric stated explicitly

fgsea run against MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets if that reference is available in the sandbox at run time; if absent, the step reports the gap explicitly and does not fabricate a substitute collection
Gene set size window of 15-500 members among tested genes applied, and stated
BH adjustment of pathway p-values; redundant/overlapping significant pathways collapsed with one representative reported and the full table kept as supplement
Report names the gene-set database, its version, the ranking metric, the universe, and the size window

steps.name: Consolidated DE + pathway report
steps.question: What is the complete, reproducible summary of genes and hallmark pathways that change between AD lesional and control skin, including the QC decision on sample_01, method versions, thresholds, and the DESeq2/edgeR concordance?

grounding.reason: Report step must carry the full reproducibility fields (R-0041), enrichment-specific reporting fields (R-0051), the method-dependence caveat on enrichment (R-0055), and the DESeq2/edgeR overlap framing (R-0042).

acceptance_criteria: Report states: package versions, design formula, reference level, named contrast, pre-filter and significance thresholds (padj<0.05, min_count=10/6 samples)
Reports n genes tested, n DE genes (DESeq2), n DE genes (edgeR), and the size of their intersection (high-confidence set)
States the sample_01 QC decision and rationale explicitly, referencing the T1S1 evidence
Reports hallmark pathway results with database version, ranking metric, universe, and size window, or explicitly states the reference was unavailable
Top DE genes and top hallmark pathways presented as tables; enrichment result explicitly framed as method-dependent / hypothesis-generating, not proven

plan.title: AD lesional vs control: DE genes and hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: 12,000-gene x 12-sample raw Salmon count matrix, 6 lesional vs 6 control skin, unpaired, single batch. Sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median. Following the recommended DESeq2 workflow: (1) inspect sample structure (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library size/detected-gene table) to decide, with a stated reason, whether sample_01 is kept, kept-and-flagged, or excluded — never dropped by default on depth alone; (2) minimal count pre-filter; (3) DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization and Wald test with an explicit reference level (control) and named contrast (AD_lesional vs Control); (4) apeglm shrinkage of log2FC, BH-adjusted at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering; (5) a robustness cross-check with edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test, reporting the DESeq2/edgeR overlap as the high-confidence gene set; (6) fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (human), with the size window and redundancy collapse the knowledge base specifies, checked against whatever hallmark gene-set reference the sandbox actually holds; (7) a consolidated report stating versions, design, thresholds, counts of tested/DE genes, and the QC decision on sample_01 explicitly.
